title: langchain==1.5.0
excerpt: langchain 1.5.0 drops support for Python 3.10 , which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11, and the minimum langchain-core version is now 1.8.0. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve langchain 1.4.x. Changes since langchain==1.4.10 release(langchain): 1.5.0 ( #41798 ) fix(langchain): mark ModelRouterMiddleware as beta ( #41797 ) feat(langchain): Remove EOL'd Python 3.10 from langchain_v1 ( #41301 ) feat(langchain): add model router and auto mode middleware ( #41766 ) docs(langchain): explain Baseten minimum version ( #41777 )
